title: Ideas
subtitle: Your recipes and your inspirations, ordered by your stock, the season, your prices and your restrictions. Everything is computed here, from your data.
search: Search a title or a label
restrictions-hint: Leave empty to check your own restrictions.
restrictions-none: No restriction to check. Create your profile in "People" and your restrictions will apply here.
hidden-incompatible: {count} incompatible idea is hidden | {count} incompatible ideas are hidden
empty: No idea yet. Add recipes or write down inspirations: they will show here.
missing-more: Missing: {foods} and {count} more | Missing: {foods} and {count} more
hint-help: "Looks vegetarian" and "Looks vegan" are hints from the names of the ingredients, never a verification.
order-help: The order changes each day. The ideas that use your stock and the produce in season come first.

generate.title: New ideas from the assistant
generate.help: The assistant suggests ideas for dishes. Each idea is kept as an inspiration: nothing becomes a recipe before you validate it, and the application checks each idea itself.
generate.sent: What goes to the AI provider: the month, the produce in season, your wish without the names of the people on record, and what you tick below. Nothing else.
generate.hint-placeholder: For example: a stew, without the oven
generate.use-stock-help: Sends the names of the foods in stock, without the quantities.
generate.include-constraints-help: Sends cooking instructions such as "gluten-free". Never a name, a reason or a medical detail.
generate.unavailable: The assistant did not answer. The idea feed works without it.
generate.done: {count} idea added to the inspirations | {count} ideas added to the inspirations
generate.disabled: The AI assistant is not configured: this feed only uses your data.
